insight: Spans macOS, Windows, iOS and Android — one of the few AI dictation tools on all four, with a custom dictionary that syncs across them.
name: Wispr Flow
tagline: AI voice dictation that types for you across every app, on desktop and mobile.
description: A dictation tool that turns speech into clean, formatted text in any app — removing filler words and applying context-aware edits as you talk. One subscription works across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android, syncing your custom vocabulary and snippets between devices.
